source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: No hole map found. Only 10 of 18 holes traced and their numbers are a best fit of the card's pars and lengths to what the photo shows (clubhouse in the east, a long strip along the canal, a western loop); the order is not known

unsure.9: number guessed: a long hole finishing beside the clubhouse past the lake
unsure.10: number guessed: a short hole from the tees beside the clubhouse to the green behind the lake
unsure.11: number guessed: runs west along the canal strip
unsure.13: number guessed; tee placed at the east end of the open fairway
unsure.14: number guessed; north-west green not clear in the photo, placed beside its bunkers
unsure.16: number guessed; traces shorter than the card, tee placed near the previous green
unsure.17: number guessed from the card's par 3 length
unsure.18: numbered as the long closing hole east along the canal to the green by the clubhouse
unsure.2-8: numbers inferred, not seen: the greens in the middle strip and south-west form one loop (down the strip, back west along the south, a par 3 north, east along the north, up the strip, a par 3 east) whose lengths fit holes 2-8 of the card in order and end 150 m from the 9th tee; no hole map checked
unsure.2: tee not seen; placed on the open ground just west of the tennis courts, a short walk from the 1st green
